reviews.comment: Although she doesn't post exam grades on canvas, it's a little difficult to know your exact grade in the class. However I like how she gives off a review sheet about 5 days prior before the exam. The review sheet is tedious since not every question will be used on the exam and takes time to complete it. Ensure that you go to class for free points.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Newman is amazing at teaching geology and she can answer just about any question you have. However she doesnt put grades in the gradebook and every test is all short answer response. She gives out a helpful review, but its hard to score a high A on the test because she's a particular grader. She gives out free 100's on worksheets, go to class

Dr. Newman is easily my favorite geology professor at A&M. She is so engaging in class and it is so clear how much she wants her students to succeed. She doesn't put anything online which seems daunting early in the semester but if you go to class and take good notes you will have everything you need to pass the course. Great test reviews as well.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great lecturer, engaging & passionate. Makes sure everyone understands the concept being taught before moving on. Answer her questions during lecture & she'll like you. Tests are all free response but she gives out a great review beforehand, study it well & you'll do fine. Book not needed if you show up to lectures & pay attention. Very minimal HW

Your grade is mostly the 2 midterms and the final. Attendance is basically mandatory because if you show up she'll basically pass you. I would recommend reading the textbook for this class because there's not a ton of resources bedsides herself and TA's outside of class. Exams are not excruciatingly difficult but are mildly hard. Cant keep exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: You can do well by either reading the textbook OR taking class notes but both are not necessarily required. Some of her test questions can be interpreted differently and depending on how many people miss it, she will give points back but not when you want her to. You can write what you missed on test but cant keep it.

I had Newman for Physical Geology first semester freshman year. She's an exceptionally caring professor and a fantastic lecturer. I'd easily take her again in a heartbeat. If you show up to class and pay attention, you'll at least get a B. Very minimal homework. Labs were long but a good introduction to later geology.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures
